newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed after range-trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed after range-trade.

text.p: Yen-based Tokyo rubber futures ended mixed on Friday after drifting within a tight range in thin trade, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.9 yen per kg lower to 0.5 yen higher.
Benchmark November closed 0.1 yen higher at 138.1 yen.
Trade was dominated by position-adjustment ahead of the weekend amid a dearth of fresh factors, the traders said.

"Interest in rubber futures remained thin as investors are eyeing more volatile commodity futures such as platinum group metals," one trader said. "The dull market is likely to continue for some time," he said.
